text:
alex: quick heads-up: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/21405 is ready for merge but e2e is flaky on CI. need a re-run and an approve if it passes. aiming to land before the blackout at 17:00 PT.

maria: looking now, thanks. is this blocked on a rebase or just CI instability?

alex: no rebase needed, it's a straight fix for the batching edge case. ci failure looks like a timing flake in convo-flow e2e.

sam: if it's just timing we can try a quick rerun and then use the 1-hour rebase window later if needed. want to avoid the full deploy freeze. @maria any objections?

maria: +1 to retry. i'll hold off approving until green. if it fails twice we should schedule a canary slot after the freeze.

ci-bot: Build #4123 started for PR 21405 — linux, mac, e2e-matrix.

jen: leaving a quick review note: one small nits but not blocking. alex, want me to address or squash? :thumbsup:

alex: squash is fine, will push a tiny commit to fix lint.

ci-bot: Build #4123 failed — e2e: convo-flow-spec timed out on mac-latest. See logs: https://ci.redwood/job/4123/logs

sam: if it's a timeout we can extend that specific test's timeout for stability (short-term) and follow up with a test rewrite. who owns convo-flow? @jen?

jen: i can take a look after this run. quick patch to timeout may help land before freeze but i'll file a GH issue to avoid permanent timeout increases.

alex: re-running now with only e2e-matrix: `/ci retry --scope=e2e-matrix`

ci-bot: Requeueing e2e-matrix for PR 21405 (retry by alex).

maria: pinging release ops — if this passes, please reserve a short gap to land before 17:00 PT. we don't want to jam the queue during blackout. @sam fyi for handoff.

sam: noted. i'll watch the queue and coordinate the merge window. if it fails again we'll defer until the post-freeze canary.

ci-bot: Build #4124 started (re-run e2e).

ci-bot: Build #4124 succeeded — all checks green.

maria: green. approving now. :white_check_mark:

jen: approved as well — go for it when you have queue space.

alex: merging in 2 mins. thanks all for fast eyes. will follow up with the GH issue for the flaky test.

sam: thanks — i'll open a short deploy window and watch for fallout. :rocket:
